headline: On November 17, 2003: Arnold Schwarzenegger becomes California governor
captionCards: First actor to become U.S. governor, bridging entertainment and politics
instagramCaption:
Arnold Schwarzenegger takes office as California's 38th governor.

He was an Austrian-born actor and bodybuilder with global film fame.
His tenure began after a recall election in 2003.
He had previously earned a Golden Globe and a Primetime Emmy.

His rise from Hollywood icon to state leader reshaped political celebrity culture.

What do you think made his transition so unexpected?
